schema_notes: rate is a fraction of road_tax_base. max_inr null = no upper bound. Any field null = could not be verified. coverage: verified | partial | secondary_only | not_found.

gst_context.summary: From 22-09-2025 (GST 2.0, 56th GST Council): small cars (petrol <=1200cc / diesel <=1500cc and length <=4m) 18%; other cars/SUVs 40%; EVs 5%; compensation cess abolished on cars. Ex-showroom already includes GST; Telangana life tax is levied on this GST-inclusive invoice cost.

central_registration.basis: Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989, Rule 81 fee table (central rule; applies in every state). States may add service/user/postal charges, not verified here.
central_registration.ev_exemption: Battery-operated vehicles exempt from fee for issue/renewal of RC and assignment of new registration mark: MoRTH G.S.R. 525(E), 2 Aug 2021 (cited on transport.karnataka.gov.in fee-exemption link; text not re-read here).
central_registration.verified: central-rule figures reproduced on Telangana transport site; state add-ons not verified

hsrp_rule: HSRP on new vehicles must be supplied by manufacturer via dealer and its cost included in vehicle price; no separate itemised charge allowed (Motor Vehicles (High Security Registration Plates) Order 2018 / CMVR r.50, effective 1 Apr 2019).

TS.name: Telangana
TS.road_tax_basis: Life tax under Telangana Motor Vehicles Taxation Act 1963, Sixth (individual) and Seventh (company / second vehicle) Schedules as substituted by G.O.Ms.No.53 TR&B (Tr.I) dt 13-08-2025, in force 14-08-2025.
TS.road_tax_base: 'Cost of the vehicle' = invoice price incl. GST and other levies, cash/trade discounts NOT deducted, and not less than manufacturer ex-showroom price (s.2(aa), inserted by TS MVT (Amendment) Act No.6 of 2023, w.e.f. 13-04-2023; TS High Court has held tax is on invoice cost incl. taxes).
TS.slab_boundary_wording: below 5 lakh | 5 lakh or above and below 10 lakh | 10 lakh or above and below 20 lakh | 20 lakh or above and below 50 lakh | above 50 lakh (exactly 50 lakh is ambiguous in the G.O.; treated as 20-50 slab)
TS.fuel_differential: None. Petrol, diesel, CNG and hybrid pay the same life tax; no hybrid concession found.
TS.second_vehicle_rule: Additional 2% over Sixth Schedule rate for second or more personalised vehicles (seating up to 10) owned by an individual, at new registration only (G.O.Ms.No.53). Telangana HC (LiveLaw report) held it cannot be levied if first vehicle was sold before permanent registration of the new one. Feb 2026 reports say CM approved abolishing the 2% surcharge; NO G.O. found and the official life-tax page still shows it (checked 2026-10-19).

ev.conditions: EVs purchased and registered in Telangana; no cap on number of vehicles (secondary reports). Covers 2W, 4W private cars, taxis, autos, LGVs, buses.

cess.applies_to: new non-transport Light Motor Vehicle (car) at first registration, one time
cess.law: s.3-C + Ninth Schedule, Telangana MVT (Amendment) Act 2026 (L.A. Bill No.5 of 2026, Gazette 02-01-2026)
cess.effective: 2026-03-01 (G.O.Ms.No.10 dt 25-02-2026, per The South First; G.O. text not retrieved)

registration.note: Fees per CMVR Rule 81 as reproduced on TS transport site. User-charge tables on TS site are commented out (not in force on page) so service charge unverified. Since Jan 2026 TS allows registration at dealer point with RC sent by speed post; no separate fee published.

TS.green_tax: Not applicable to new cars (only non-transport vehicles >15 yrs old; G.O.Ms.No.23 dt 07-05-2022).
notes: Hyderabad/GHMC: no separate road tax, cess or registration fee found; life tax is state-wide. Difference is insurance zone (Hyderabad = Zone A for OD tariff reference; rest of Telangana = Zone B).

Old battery/CNG 5-year tax exemption (G.O.Ms.No.82 of 1993) shown on TS tax-exemption page appears to relate to periodic tax and is not applied to private car life tax in practice - treat as not applicable (unverified).

Telangana Transport Dept ordered statewide showroom inspections against handling/logistics/delivery/documentation fees and missing Temporary Registration (NewsMeter, 1 Jul 2026; circular no. not found).

insurance.tp_notification: Motor Vehicles (Third Party Insurance Base Premium and Liability) Rules 2022, MoRTH in consultation with IRDAI, notified 25-05-2022, effective 01-06-2022. G.S.R. number not verified. As of 2026-10-19 no newer notified revision found (hike proposals of 10-25% reported in 2025-26 but not gazetted).
insurance.tp_discounts: 7.5% discount on premium for electric and hybrid electric vehicles per SCC Online summary of 2022 rules (other outlets conflict) - verify; not applied in examples.
insurance.pa_cover_note: Compulsory personal accident cover for owner-driver, sum insured Rs15 lakh (IRDAI 2018). Premium is insurer-filed; not a single notified figure. Can be skipped only if owner already has a standalone PA policy of >= Rs15 lakh or holds no driving licence.

od_estimate.label: ESTIMATE ONLY - own damage is insurer-priced (de-tariffed since 2007).
od_estimate.idv_formula: IDV = ex-showroom price x (1 - depreciation); depreciation 5% for vehicle age <= 6 months (new car). Accessories add-on separately.
od_estimate.ncb: Not applicable to a new car (0%), unless transferred from a previous vehicle.
od_estimate.discount_note: Reference rates are the old India Motor Tariff schedule; actual insurer quotes are typically discounted from these. Treat tariff x IDV as an upper reference, not a quote. Typical discount range: null (not verified).
od_estimate.ev_note: No official OD reference by kW found; using cc>1500 band as a proxy is an assumption.

tcs.threshold_rule: applies when value of the motor vehicle sale EXCEEDS Rs10,00,000 (exactly 10L = no TCS)
tcs.base: Entire sale consideration on the dealer invoice (not only the excess over 10L). Commonly applied on the GST-inclusive invoice value; registration, road tax and insurance are not part of the dealer's sale consideration (interpretation, verify).
tcs.law: Income-tax Act 1961 s.206C(1F) until 31-03-2026; from 01-04-2026 Income-tax Act 2025 s.394 (table entry; sub-section cited inconsistently by secondary sources). Rate and threshold unchanged for tax year 2026-27.
tcs.refundable: Not a cost: TCS is credited to buyer's PAN (Form 26AS/AIS) and adjusted against income-tax liability or refunded via ITR.

fastag_detail.note: Car (VC4) typical: Rs100 issuance (often waived) + Rs200 refundable deposit + any opening balance. Issuer-dependent. Not verified on IHMCL/NHAI official page. Optional FASTag Annual Pass (Rs3,000 for 200 trips/1 yr, from 15-08-2025) is not part of on-road price.

disallowed_charges.item: Handling / logistics / delivery / PDI / documentation charges
disallowed_charges.status: not a statutory charge; Telangana Transport Dept ordered dealer inspections and refunds for unauthorised charges (Jul 2026); Delhi, Kerala and Telangana transport depts issued earlier public notices (Deccan Chronicle)
must be included in vehicle price for new vehicles (HSRP Order 2018)

disallowed_charges.item: Separate temporary registration fee beyond govt fee
disallowed_charges.status: TR must be issued via Vahan before delivery; dealer markup not allowed (amount unverified)

disallowed_charges.item: Accessories pack / essential kit / coating / anti-rust
disallowed_charges.status: optional; cannot be made a condition of sale (consumer protection - no specific official notice found)
buyer may buy insurance from any insurer; only valid TP cover required before registration
mandatory fitment on new 4W (CMVR); dealer may charge the issuer fee only
